name: Trilinear Interpolation (Compressed/Linked)
definition: Performs trilinear interpolation on a compressed sparse grid using a links array to map voxel indices to compressed value indices, handling boundary checks via masking.
summary: Trilinear Interpolation (Compressed/Linked) performs trilinear interpolation on a compressed sparse grid using a links array to map voxel indices to compressed values, providing sharper renderings than nearest neighbor interpolation.
